items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I don't know, but I would be one bit surprised. Whiteman with Gershwin.

ctx.x: I guess so. Maybe that's where Mildred got it. Who knows? She was contemporary with him. It could be.
I don't know, but I would be one bit surprised. Whiteman with Gershwin.
Most people who get involved seriously with their horn are not turned off by this, and even more sparked by it; I know that Charlie Parker was. I know that because he told me so.
